# README artwork

`tapid-banner.png` is the Tapid README banner, generated with the built-in image generation tool. It uses white typography on a subtle black gradient.

## Generation prompt

The banner was subsequently edited using the following prompt. The generated file retained a 3:1 aspect ratio; the README displays it at 85% width to reduce its height.

Edit this Tapid README banner to make it more compact vertically, with a panoramic 4:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 by 512 pixels. Remove some empty space above and below the centered wordmark. Preserve the exact text "Tapid" and "by LimeTip", capitalization, geometric sans-serif typography, warm-white color, and subtle black-to-charcoal gradient. Keep comfortable margins and make the text slightly smaller if necessary so nothing is clipped. No graphics or additional elements. The result should occupy less vertical space in a GitHub README while remaining readable on mobile.

## Original generation prompt

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: panoramic GitHub README banner, approximately 3:1, for Tapid by LimeTip.
Create a very restrained typographic banner. Background is a smooth near-black to charcoal gradient with a faint soft lift in brightness around the center. Clean, flat, understated graphic design. Center a large warm-white word "Tapid" in bold, carefully spaced geometric sans-serif typography. Directly underneath, smaller warm-white text "by LimeTip". These are the only words. Preserve the exact capitalization. Generous empty space around the text. No boxes, package graphics, dependency graphs, icons, objects, illustrations, 3D rendering, neon glow, ornaments, textures, badges, borders, shadows on the text, or decorative labels. Typography should be sharp and readable at both desktop and mobile README widths.
